-- Check how many of these drivers are affected by pit stop exclusions
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position,
           prev_position - position as pos_change
    FROM race_laps
    WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap as pit_lap,
           lap + 1 as pit_lap_plus_1
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(lap AS BIGINT) as ret_lap
    FROM retirements
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT pc.*
    FROM position_changes pc
    LEFT JOIN pit_stop_laps ps ON pc.race_id = ps.race_id AND pc.driver_id = ps.driver_id 
        AND pc.lap IN (ps.pit_lap, ps.pit_lap_plus_1)
    LEFT JOIN retirement_laps rl ON pc.race_id = rl.race_id AND pc.driver_id = rl.driver_id AND pc.lap = rl.ret_lap
    WHERE ps.pit_lap IS NULL AND rl.ret_lap IS NULL
)
SELECT driver_id,
       ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN pos_change ELSE 0 END)) as total_overtakes,
       ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN pos_change ELSE 0 END)) as times_overtaken
FROM filtered_changes
GROUP BY driver_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN pos_change ELSE 0 END)) > ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN pos_change ELSE 0 END))
ORDER BY times_overtaken - total_overtakes DESC
LIMIT 20
